aboutUs.introText: Gazmatek was founded by music enthusiasts with the goal of showcasing Belgian artists eager to be heard and creating unique experiences for all participants. Our mission is to discover and deliver exceptional moments through music, offering a platform where local talents can shine and where everyone can feel fully immersed in a unique musical atmosphere.

collectiveIntro.title: The Collective
collectiveIntro.text: Gazmatek is a Belgian sound system built by passionate people: artists, sound engineers and event organisers. Self-managed and fully reinvested in sound, production and live performance, the crew has been pushing underground tekno since 2016. Resident artists, record label, equipment rental — all converge on a single sonic obsession.

list.name: SOUND SYSTEM RENTAL
list.title: Opt for an impeccable sound ambiance with our Sound System Rental service
list.description: Gazmatek offers various audio system solutions suitable for events of all sizes. Our wide range of audio equipment is complemented by the expertise of our sound engineers. The quality of our services is our priority. By opting for this service, you will guarantee your clientele a professional and immersive acoustic experience.

list.name: LIGHT SHOW
list.title: Bring a captivating visual dimension to every moment, that's our promise with our Light Show service
list.description: Gazmatek takes special care in transforming your event into a dynamic space, creating a memorable experience for your clientele. Our lighting engineers rely on solid field experience, allowing us to offer solutions tailored to every request.

list.name: SOUND SYSTEM TUNING
list.title: Optimize the acoustics of your venue with our professional Sound System Tuning service.
list.description: Our sound experts ensure to create an exceptional auditory experience for those who will enjoy your sound system. Trust Gazmatek to adjust your system with precision, ensuring incomparable sound quality. We intervene on both permanent and temporary systems and also assist you in using your equipment.

list.name: SPEAKER RESTORATION
list.title: Give new life to your speakers with our Speaker Restoration service.
list.description: At Gazmatek, we repair, maintain, and optimize your audio equipment to ensure long-term performance. Our specialized technicians apply their expertise to sound quality, extending the life of your speakers and ensuring a sound faithful to the original.

list.name: SCENOGRAPHY
list.title: Bring your ideas to life with our Scenography service.
list.description: Our teams collaborate with you to create an evocative and memorable stage. Supported by the expertise of our engineers in the field, we create an unforgettable visual experience for your guests.

list.name: LINE-UP DESIGN
list.title: Let us compose the optimal musical experience with our Line-Up Design service.
list.description: We build each line-up to match the essence, budget, and scale of your event. Gazmatek collaborates with a multitude of renowned artists as well as emerging talents, allowing us to create a musical program perfectly suited to your needs.

list.name: CUSTOM EVENT
list.title: Create unique moments with our Custom Event service.
list.description: At Gazmatek, every detail is considered to personalize your event according to your needs and wishes. We put our creativity at the service of realizing your ideas, ensuring a tailor-made experience that will leave a lasting impression.

list.name: DECORATION
list.title: Transform your space with our Decoration service.
list.description: With experience in development and design of decors, Gazmatek enhances your events with professionally finished creations. Our technique of blending raw materials with electronics allows for dynamic decors with a polished finish.
